findings.text: Host reports Memory Protection Extensions state as available only when both bound register and bound status extended state components are advertised in the supported extended control mask.

Startup discovery clears the save and emulated and feature tallies then probes host support for base entries and conditionally for performance entries and filters emulated entries through vendor approval and probes virtualization feature identifiers.
Build enforces an assumption of exactly 3 fixed performance counters when assembling the save set.

Speculation control probe validates a candidate value against host hardware while preserving the prior host setting across the test and suppressing interrupts, reporting acceptance versus host refusal.
Emulated virtualization capability range begins with basic capabilities and ends with virtual machine function capabilities.
Internal guest shadow stack pointer identifier has value 0x4b564dff.
Default page attribute table repeats a four entry sequence of write back then write through then uncacheable minus then uncacheable across eight slots.
Register access rights encode read as bit 0 and write as bit 1 with combined access as the union of both.
Register handling reports unsupported with value 2 and filtered with value 3.
User control flow enforcement state reserves bits 6 through 9 and dedicates bits 0 to 1 to shadow stack control and bits 2 to 5 plus bits 10 upward to branch tracking control.
Diagnostic messages from memory type and performance subsystems are prefixed with the module name.
Public headers protect against multiple inclusion with single definition guards.
Performance event filter for a virtual machine holds at most 300 entries.
Virtualized performance monitoring starts enabled while mediated passthrough starts disabled, with separate records for host observed and guest exposed capabilities kept in mostly read state.

In kernel event filter describes desired disposition plus total length plus fixed counter selection plus option flags plus split counts for accepted and rejected groups with pointers into a trailing variable length list sized by the total.
Emulated selector cache stores host encodings for retired instruction counting and for retired branch counting.
Precise sampling distribution support is recognized on specific server families including two Ice Lake server variants and Sapphire Rapids server, with accurate distribution limited to the latter.
Vendor performance operations dispatch through indirect static calls with required entries warning when missing and optional entries tolerating absence including silent zero return.

Vendor operation bundle groups counter translation plus validation plus register access plus lifecycle management plus interrupt delivery plus mediated loading plus topology limits plus register bases with a common stride.
Vendor registration replaces the global operation set and refreshes all indirect dispatch targets from the supplied table.

Capability setup derives guest visible version and counter counts from host measurements with clamping to supported maxima and caches host encodings for emulated instruction and branch events, disabling the facility when host resources are absent or insufficient.
Hybrid processors have virtualized performance monitoring disabled because current interfaces cannot express heterogeneous topology until an explicit userspace opt in exists.
Mediated passthrough remains available only when global and mediated enables and host mediation and vendor acceptance all agree, otherwise the global control hook is cleared.
Mediated interrupt handling from the running processor requests a performance interrupt for its virtual processor and warns when invoked without a running context or without mediation.

Asynchronous counter overflow for a counter already marked for reprogramming is ignored so stale notifications racing with guest reconfiguration do not cause duplicate work, otherwise overflow is recorded and further handling is requested.

Counter writes under mediation store a width masked value directly while other writes discard accumulated software counts and rebase the stored offset relative to current hardware progress before refreshing sampling state.
Sampling period refresh occurs only when a live performance event exists and counting is not paused and the event uses sampling.
Early counter read validation delegates to vendor logic when present and otherwise succeeds, reflecting differing priority between interception and exceptions on different vendors.

Guest counter reads fail when the facility version is zero and serve backdoor time sources directly and otherwise translate the index through vendor logic and enforce privilege based on user access enable and current privilege and protection mode before returning a masked value.
Backdoor pseudo counters for host cycle count and boot relative time and guest offset time use 0x10000 and 0x10001 and 0x10002.

Counter and global control and read interception remain required whenever mediation is absent or guest topology or counter widths diverge from host, with additional forcing when backdoor counters are enabled or guest lacks global control.
Miscellaneous enable read only view for performance combines unavailable indicators for precise sampling and branch tracing.
Fixed counter base index matches the Intel fixed counter origin.
Performance interrupt delivery invokes vendor handling then signals the local interrupt controller when the interrupt controller is emulated in the kernel.
Per virtual processor performance initialization clears the state record then runs vendor specific setup.

Filter preparation normalizes legacy entries into masked form then validates masked bits then orders entries by event identity with rejected entries last then splits the ordered list into accepted and rejected partitions.
Masked entries may only use event identity plus unit mask value and mask plus exclusion marking, while legacy entries with wider bits are dropped for compatibility.
Filter configuration accepts only allow or deny dispositions with recognized flags and bounded length and reports user copy faults and size violations.

Filter replacement exchanges the shared pointer under the virtual machine mutex then waits for readers to drain before freeing the prior table and marking every virtual processor for reprogramming and requesting handling.
Counter and selector register addresses derive from per type bases plus index scaled by a common stride.

Mediated guest entry loads host perf context and globally disables counting and restores interrupt controller and counter state before vendor handling, while exit reverses through vendor handling and harvesting and clearing of hardware state before releasing perf context, skipping both when mediation or kernel interrupt control is absent.

Entry writes guest counter values only when different from hardware and always restores selectors, while exit saves hardware progress into software and clears nonzero hardware registers to avoid host counting under guest controls.
Mediated load and unload require interrupts disabled and assert that state, while speculation control probing saves and restores interrupt state across host register access.
Overflow versus reprogram races resolve through atomic set of a per counter pending marker with the loser discarding its notification.
Loading guest selectors while global enable remains set risks spurious counts and interrupts so entry explicitly clears global enable even on platforms that switch enables at transition.
Counter lookup by linear index or register address returns absence when outside guest visible ranges and constrains speculation past bounds during array access.
